title: An 8-foot Bigfoot was spotted in Connecticut last month. It’s far from New England’s first.
author: Elizabeth Mehler
bullets: Kevin Klimas reported an 8-foot Bigfoot sighting in Voluntown, Connecticut, on July 5.
Since 1994, New England has had 126 verified Bigfoot sightings, according to the BFRO.
BU professor Eva Garrett claims there's no scientific evidence supporting the existence of Bigfoot.

title: I will miss my friend Margo, who told me to grieve, but not too much
author: Meredith Goldstein
bullets: Margo Howard, daughter of famed columnist Ann Landers, passed away at 86 in Cambridge.
Margo Howard was known for her forthright advice, writing columns such as Dear Prudence and Dear Margo.
Advice columnist Meredith Goldstein reflects on Margo's impact, notably her counsel to grieve but also embrace happiness.

title: Red Sox bats, Payton Tolle’s 14 strikeouts stifle Athletics, 13-1
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Payton Tolle struck out a career-high 14 batters in the Red Sox's 13-1 win over the Athletics.
The game extended the Red Sox's winning streak to nine games with a record of 64-51 this season.
Boston's offense accumulated 15 hits, leading to multiple high-scoring innings against Athletics pitcher Jake Perkins.

title: A.J. Brown and Christian Gonzalez continue sharpening each other’s games at Patriots training camp
author: Colin McCarthy
bullets: A.J. Brown and Christian Gonzalez engage in competitive training camp matchups to sharpen their skills for the 2026 NFL season.
Christian Gonzalez uses intentional trash talk to prepare A.J. Brown for encounters with other top cornerbacks during the season.
The New England Patriots are considering offering Christian Gonzalez a new contract amid his active participation in training camp.

title: New Red Sox catcher Adley Rutschman to begin rehab assignment this weekend
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Adley Rutschman will start a rehab assignment with Triple-A Worcester on Saturday after being sidelined by left wrist inflammation.
Rutschman was acquired from the Orioles in exchange for three prospects and Carlos Narvaez at the trade deadline.
Boston Red Sox interim manager Chad Tracy confirms Rutschman will catch five innings in his first game back.

title: 5 must-watch movies & TV shows streaming right now
author: Kevin Slane
bullets: 'Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender' debuts on Paramount+ nearly 20 years after the original series finale.
'The Ballad of Wallis Island,' starring Tim Key, is now streaming on Peacock.
'Ted Lasso' Season 4 returns with the coach now leading a women's team at AFC Richmond, available on Apple TV.

title: Could Garrett Crochet return to Red Sox in a bullpen role?
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Garrett Crochet is eyeing a return to the Red Sox bullpen in 2026 following injury setbacks.
Interim manager Chad Tracy downplayed Crochet's ability to pitch as a starter this season.
Crochet is open to a bullpen role to contribute to the Red Sox's successful 2026 campaign.

title: Lost a python? Boston Animal Care and Control might have it.
author: Heather Alterisio
bullets: A ball python, temporarily named 'Tippy,' was found near Ellington Street in Dorchester on Wednesday.
Residents reported seeing an individual leave the snake in a cage at a community food garden.
Boston Animal Care and Control is caring for the python and seeking its owner by calling 617-635-1800.

title: Tommy DeVito bests Drake Maye, and other takeaways from Patriots’ training camp scrimmage
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Tommy DeVito led Team Blue to a 22-15 victory over Drake Maye's Team White in the Patriots' scrimmage.
DeVito completed 13-of-16 passes with two touchdowns, outperforming Maye, who had 10-of-19 with two touchdowns.
Patriots players Will Campbell and Carlton Davis remain out with injuries, with updates expected after the weekend.

title: A closer look at Harwich, voted the best town on Cape Cod by Boston.com readers
author: Kristi Palma
bullets: Harwich was voted the best town on Cape Cod by more than 850 Boston.com readers in an informal poll.
Harwich spans nearly 11 miles of tidal shoreline along the Nantucket Sound and Pleasant Bay with over 20 beaches.
Harwich offers diverse attractions, including conservation areas, community centers, and cultural sites for visitors of all ages.
